content:
Hi everyone I'm considering starting a new project in Verso, but I'm completely new to Verso and, more generally, to Lean metaprogramming at this scale.

I've looked through the official documentation and manual, but I'm finding it difficult to get started. Most of the material seems to be a reference rather than a beginner-oriented guide. Can anyone recommend any tutorials, guides, blog posts, or example projects good for learning Verso?

Have you seen the Verso examples on live.lean-lang.org? (Examples dropdown in the upper right.) That provides some smaller more bite-sized examples and may help with the “how do I get started” question. We do know improved official “what are the available roles and directives and examples of all of these” are needed.
wow that's nice; I'll have a look thank you very much.
